notes: Firepower ball saver kicker causality. Figure 3 puts solenoid 07 (Left Ball Saver Kicker) at the foot of the left outlane, whose rollover is public 10, and lamp 2 is BALL SAVER KICKER ON. The booklet lists two adjustable ways to light it: the three POWER targets (public 39, 40, 41) or making targets 1-3 or 4-6 on the same ball (public 17, 18, 19 and 21, 22, 23). The first pulse of 10 with lamp 2 unlit is the control; the POWER targets and then targets 1-3 are made, and a second pulse of 10 should pulse solenoid 7 once lamp 2 is lit. Run from an NVRAM initialized by one prior empty-NVRAM power-up.
